title: Murderer Got Released From Jail & Then Did it Again
description:
Late at night, emergency dispatch receives a call about a serious altercation involving an elderly man named David and Phillip, a 59-year-old former boxer recently released from prison. As multiple emergency responders rush to the scene, another call comes in—witnesses report that Phillip, who had been involved in the altercation, is now performing CPR on David.
Inside the house, authorities restrict access to certain footage, but the audio reveals critical details about the situation. When questioned by officers, Phillip shares an unexpected truth—it all started with the crinkle of a chocolate wrapper. There is a clear sense of regret in his voice, but his past suggests a pattern of troubled decisions.
According to reports, Phillip has faced significant legal issues in the past, struggling with personal challenges that led to multiple encounters with law enforcement. He had previously served time and faced difficulties reintegrating into society, finding himself caught in a cycle that was hard to escape.
Phillip claims that David approached him and initiated the confrontation, but a staff member from the residence provides a different account. As the investigation unfolds, Phillip reveals a critical detail—he immediately knew the impact of his actions.
Ultimately, authorities determine the severity of the situation, and Phillip faces serious legal consequences, with bail set at $4 million.

The raw footage for the videos on this channel have been obtained directly from the respective Police Departments. We as a media company have the right to use it commercially. Most incidents may require a fee associated with the request and take several days to process.

The channel is not affiliated with any law enforcement agency.

Our channel is compliant with YouTube's Fair Use Policy as we create a storyline and cut down several hours of long footage to a few minutes to bring out the most entertaining and educational parts, just like other channels such as Code Blue Cam, Real World Police, Active Police Cam, Blue Watch and Bodycam FIles.

The featured content is NOT intended to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved or to glorify violence in any way.
